lines.text: I'm Gaboo, BR mod. This is the Event Arena. Weekly Events can move 200 to 300 Engage Points at once.
Two hundred points? That accelerates everything.
Exactly. But mods notice who contributes for real. Weekly shoutout adds more for people who bring energy and help newcomers.
Gaboo coordinates BR events. To stand out, bring presence, stay useful, and respect the room.
Ready? The market will not wait.
